title: Understanding Bond Yield and Return
locator: Sections 'What Is Yield?', 'Current Yield', and 'Yield to Maturity': yield to maturity as "the overall interest rate earned by an investor who buys a bond at the market price and holds it until maturity", i.e. the discount rate that equates all future coupon and principal cash flows to the current price; "Price and yield are inversely related: As the price of a bond goes up, its yield goes down, and vice versa." Page content verified on the accessed date; wording may change.
